definitions.explanation: A strong prohibition, often seen on signs and in rules. Stronger than 禁止, conveying zero tolerance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{厳禁|げんきん}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火気|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{厳禁|げんきん}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The use of open flames is strictly prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入り：10671_tachiiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳禁|げんきん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Entry is strictly prohibited for anyone other than authorized personnel.

notes:
{厳禁|げんきん} is stronger than ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibited). It implies zero tolerance and potentially severe consequences.

COMMON SIGN PATTERNS:
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{厳禁|げんきん}: photography strictly prohibited
- ⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧{厳禁|げんきん}: alcohol strictly forbidden
- ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧{厳禁|げんきん}: smoking strictly forbidden
- {火気|かき}{厳禁|げんきん}: open flames strictly prohibited
- ⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧{厳禁|げんきん}: entry strictly prohibited

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: prohibited (standard level)
- {厳禁|げんきん}: strictly prohibited (stronger, zero tolerance)

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧ (cash), which has the same reading but different kanji.
